CREATE TABLE "public"."audit_logs" (
  "action" text NOT NULL,
  "actor_user_id" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "ip_address" text,
  "metadata" json,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid",
  "user_agent" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "audit_logs_action_check_58c7dcda" CHECK ("action" IN ('SIGN_REQUEST_CREATED', 'APPROVAL_STARTED', 'APPROVAL_APPROVED', 'APPROVAL_REJECTED', 'PIN_VERIFICATION_SUCCESS', 'PIN_VERIFICATION_FAILED', 'SIGNATURE_PROFILE_CREATED', 'SIGNATURE_PROFILE_UPDATED', 'DOCUMENT_RECEIVED', 'DOCUMENT_HASHED', 'SIGNING_STARTED', 'SIGNING_COMPLETED', 'SIGNING_FAILED', 'SIGN_REQUEST_COMPLETED', 'SIGN_REQUEST_CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."documents" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "file_key" text NOT NULL,
  "file_size" int4,
  "hash" text,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "locked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "mime_type" text,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "documents_type_check_d016bc72" CHECK ("type" IN ('FINAL', 'SIGNED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sign_request_approvals" (
  "approved_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "height" float8 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "letter_date" timestamptz,
  "letter_number" text,
  "level" text NOT NULL,
  "page" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "permission" text NOT NULL,
  "rejected_at" timestamptz,
  "rejection_reason" text,
  "required" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sequence" int4 NOT NULL,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "signer_user_id" text,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "width" float8 NOT NULL,
  "x" float8 NOT NULL,
  "y" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sign_request_approvals_level_check_534088a9" CHECK ("level" IN ('BANJAR', 'DESA')),
  CONSTRAINT "sign_request_approvals_status_check_6f336f18" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'SKIPPED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sign_requests" (
  "banjar_id" text,
  "cancelled_at" timestamptz,
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_sequence" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "reference_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'PENDING' NOT NULL,
  "template_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "village_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "sign_requests_status_check_18dd2aa8" CHECK ("status" IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'READY_TO_SIGN', 'PROCESSING', 'SIGNED', 'REJECTED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signature_profiles" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "signature_image_key" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signatures" (
  "algorithm" text NOT NULL,
  "approval_id" "uuid",
  "certificate_issuer" text,
  "certificate_serial" text,
  "document_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "document_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "level" text NOT NULL,
  "sign_request_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "signature_value" text NOT NULL,
  "signed_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "signer_user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "signatures_level_check_534088a9" CHECK ("level" IN ('BANJAR', 'DESA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signer_credentials" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "failed_attempt" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "last_pin_changed_at" timestamptz,
  "locked_until" timestamptz,
  "pin_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signing_template_steps" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "height" float8 NOT NULL,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "level" text NOT NULL,
  "page" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "permission" text NOT NULL,
  "required" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "sequence" int4 NOT NULL,
  "template_id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "width" float8 NOT NULL,
  "x" float8 NOT NULL,
  "y" float8 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "signing_template_steps_level_check_534088a9" CHECK ("level" IN ('BANJAR', 'DESA'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."signing_templates" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "created_by" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" "uuid" NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
